description: Mysuru teacher Madhusudan KS received the National Teachers Award 2025 from President Murmu for setting up a ‘C-Lounge’ innovation hub with robotics, AI tools, drones, and 3D printing at a government school.
body_lead: National Teachers Awards: Drones, robots and AI earn Mysuru teacher who built tech lounge in govt school President Murmu honoured Madhusudan KS with the National Teachers Award 2025 for transforming a government school into a hands-on innovation hub where students experiment with robotics, drones, 3D printing and AI tools. Mysuru teacher Madhusudan K S. Credit: X/ @EduMinOfIndia
